plugin.name: AI Chat
plugin.description: An LLM chat that can run commands on your SSH hosts and read their output.

tab.title: AI Chat
tab.empty: Start a new chat and ask the agent to do something on one of your hosts.
tab.placeholder: Ask the agent to do something…
tab.deleteConfirm: Delete this chat and its history?
tab.error: Something went wrong. Check the provider settings and try again.
tab.notConfigured: Pick a provider and model in Settings, AI Chat, then come back.
tab.noHosts: You have no hosts you can connect to yet. Add one in the Hosts tab.

approval.title: The agent wants to run this command

prompt.title: The host is asking for input
prompt.secret: Your answer is sent once and remembered for this session.

model.label: Model
model.error: Could not load models. Check your API key.

use.title: Use AI Chat
use.description: Open the AI Chat tab and let an LLM run commands on hosts you can connect to.

commandTimeoutSec.label: Command timeout (seconds)
commandTimeoutSec.description: How long a single command the agent runs may take.

maxOutputChars.label: Max output per command (characters)
maxOutputChars.description: Longer output is truncated before it reaches the model.

maxTurnsPerRun.label: Max steps per message
maxTurnsPerRun.description: How many command-and-think steps the agent may take per message.

uiPlacement.label: Where the chat lives
uiPlacement.description: Tab: opened from the sidebar rail. Panel: an entry in the sidebar, and the rail icon goes away. Takes effect right away.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Which LLM provider to use. The matching API key below is required.

apiKeyOpenrouter.label: OpenRouter API key
apiKeyOpenrouter.description: From openrouter.ai/keys. Stored encrypted, never sent to the browser.

apiKeyOpenai.label: OpenAI API key
apiKeyOpenai.description: From platform.openai.com. Stored encrypted, never sent to the browser.

apiKeyAnthropic.label: Anthropic API key
apiKeyAnthropic.description: From console.anthropic.com. Stored encrypted, never sent to the browser.

model.label: Default model
model.description: The model id new chats start with, like anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5. You can change it per chat.

reasoningEffort.label: Reasoning effort
reasoningEffort.description: How much reasoning the model should do when it supports it.

defaultApprovalMode.label: Default command approval
defaultApprovalMode.description: How new chats gate commands. You can change it per chat.

safeAllowlist.label: Safe command prefixes
safeAllowlist.description: One command per line, matched at the start of the command. Commands with pipes, ;, && or redirection are never auto-approved. Used in the auto-safe approval mode.
